text:
Aisha: Quick flag 1 trial onboarding imports failed overnight; 3 are in imminent renewal windows. Need short comms + mitigation plan to send within 3h.

incident-bot: Incident onboarding-imports: detected 2026-03-29T01:12Z, partial mitigation 2026-03-29T03:05Z.

Marco: Ill pull traces now. Which tenants?

Aisha: DM sheet: BrightLeaf (acct_bright), Meridian Health (acct_mer), PaperTrail (acct_ptrail) + 8 others. Failures mostly 01:05-01:25 UTC.

Priya: Proposed for the 3 renewal-risk tenants: 25% invoice credit + 2x enablement hours + priority manual re-ingest. Also invite to a private office hour.

Jamie: SE can run manual retries. Small runbook snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/imports/retry -d '{"tenant":"acct_bright"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'```

Ethan: Root cause: transient S3 latency during nightly GC caused the onboard queue circuit-breaker to trip. We extended timeouts and replayed stuck messages. No data loss; some imports required manual intervention. RCA being drafted.

Aisha: Draft outbound for priority tenants (short):

``
Hi <Customer>,

Were sorry 1 partial onboarding import for your account was delayed on Mar 29 UTC. Our team prioritized a retry and verified your indexed documents.

What were providing:
- Priority manual re-ingest and verification
- 25% credit on next invoice (applies once)
- Two dedicated enablement hours + private office hour invite

Reply if you want us to re-run the import immediately.

Thanks,
Aisha, Customer Success
``

Marco: Add console-check steps (preview link + sample doc count) and explicit billing language.

Priya: Ill send personalized emails to the three and automations to the rest at 08:00 UTC tomorrow. Tracking sheet & feedback form will be attached.

Jamie: SE will staff the office hour and be ready to run retries.

Ethan: Ops will publish the RCA URL after legal review.

Aisha: Plan set. Marking tenants as priority in Gainsight and notifying renewal owners. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
